dedupe_keys.name: district heating system performance charasteristics omsk russia nov 2017

description: The deposit reports daily heat production for five large district-heating plants, accompanied by outdoor temperature, network supply temperature and supply-water flow. The provider is Stanislav Chicherin. Coverage: Coverage is Omsk, Russia, in November 2017. Production is in gigacalories and the stated water-flow unit is tonnes per hour. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The deposit states a CC-BY-4.0 licence. The public deposit provides a free access route; downstream software and third-party data may have separate conditions. Limitations: One month and five plants cannot establish wider seasonal or city-system performance. Completeness and measurement quality were not independently checked. For simulation it supplies a local operating baseline for heating production and network demand comparisons. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes provides pipe-network modelling. This is a thematic link, not evidence of use in this study.
